(b) `advertep` is THE slot holding 'the endpoint this session listens on', set by every face that binds; `$/madc/serve` reads it, so an editor ATTACHED to an ORDINARY editor session is told about its window face too — the old `lspserve` slot knew only about `--lsp --serve`. Gate: scripts/check-madcide-one-accept-loop.sh (in fulltest) pins ONE serve_conn_task spawn site AND one session_advertise() per listen:// bind — a face that listens without advertising is invisible, and invisible is indistinguishable from absent, so a client silently opens a SECOND session on one file.
⚠️⚠️ THREE NEW TRAPS THIS SLICE PAID FOR, on top of the arc's five: (6) A var's `c_str()` IS A RING RENDERING, not a pointer into the carrier — a CARRIER CROSSES A FUNCTION BOUNDARY AS `var &`, never as `const char *`, when the callee calls out before it uses the value. session_record calls canonical_path + the document scan + format before placing its endpoint; passed as const char* the first run advertised `"endpoint":"tmp/discdoc.mad"` — the FILE PATH. (7) A DISCOVERING CLIENT SPENDS A CONNECTION ON THE LIVENESS PROBE BEFORE IT OPENS THE REAL ONE — a seat that accepts exactly once answers the probe and then DEADLOCKS waiting for a relay it already refused to hear. Drive the production accept loop in a test, never a single accept. (8) DRAIN A RELAY TO EOF BEFORE CLOSING IT (`while (relay.readline(tail)) ;`) or the child is cut off mid-exit and the PARENT hangs — testmadcide_attach established that discipline and testmadcide_discover had to learn it.

VLA NOT DEALLOCATED ON BACKWARD GOTO: a `goto` jumping back to before a VLA's declaration must deallocate the VLA (gcc/C semantics; gcc-torture 20040811-1.c). madc lowers VLAs as malloc + __attribute__((cleanup)), which frees only on SCOPE EXIT, not on the backward goto re-entering the scope — so a backward-goto loop over a VLA LEAKS one allocation per iteration. 20040811-1.c leaks ~2GB over 1e6 iterations; it passes only when memory is available (it OOM-SIGSEGV'd when the MIR fork's 128MB code-holder reservation reduced headroom — see mir_fork; arch-gated off x86-64, so it passes again). Proper fix: free the VLA at the backward goto. Separate future slice.
